policy.requirementOrigin: User requested aquarium tanks be destroyed when hit by a bullet.
policy.response: Shattered glazing, drained water and static glass/debris art

checks: All three tank types have usable intact/destroyed variants
One selected target changes while 49 other tanks retain identical geometry
Intact glass, water and swimming fish leave the raycast/draw prefix
Current instanceId metadata remains valid after compaction
Repeated hit presentation is idempotent; reset restores exact initial geometry
State changes create no new geometry, material or instance objects
Owned resources dispose once; intact dimensions remain unchanged
limits: Presentation/contract checks only. A live bullet-impact, collider update and persistence implementation remain coder-owned.
